relevance_note: Case report of two siblings homozygous for an LPIN2 nonsense variant: 'homozygous mutation was detected in exon 4 of the LPIN2 (NM_014646.2) gene; c.589C>T (p. Arg197Ter) in both patients'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans and fields. Four in-scope people: Patient 1 (the paper's label), his sister (no own label: 'sister of Patient 1'), and the two parents, described only as 'parents' without sex ('parent of Patient 1', 'parent of Patient 1 2'), who are stated carriers of the variant. Parents' zygosity left 'not reported' because the paper says 'carriers', not 'heterozygous'. Inheritance for the homozygous siblings left 'not reported': both parents are stated carriers, and the schema enum has no value for biparental inheritance; the statement is in parental_testing_statement. Pathogenicity left 'not reported': the only classification given ('pathogenic') is ClinVar's interpretation, not the authors' own. Ages given are ages at presentation ('A seven-year-old boy presented', 'who was 18 months old presented'), not at last evaluation or diagnosis, so those fields are 'not reported'; the sister's onset is given only as 'during the last six months' before presentation, recorded as feature onset text without an ISO value. Normal physical examination recorded as 'abnormal physical examination findings' excluded, with no more specific exclusions drawn from it (D-27); hence hepatomegaly/splenomegaly are 'not reported'. 'No joint swelling' for Patient 1 does not exclude the composite checklist item 'joint or limb swelling' (left not reported). Checklist CRMO: Patient 1 marked excluded from 'despite absence of osteitis in his WB-MRI'; sister marked observed from multifocal bilateral osteitis on whole-body MRI (the paper does not use the term CNO/CRMO for her). Sister's bone marrow 'megaloblastic changes' not mapped to the checklist item 'dyserythropoiesis on bone marrow' (left not reported). Patient 1's 'mild anemia' is not called microcytic (checklist not reported). Post-treatment statements ('remained free of symptoms with normal APRs on anakinra treatment') describe the course on therapy and were not recorded as exclusions; persisting neutropenia ('they still have neutropenia (900/mm^3)') is added as detail for both siblings. Paper prints the protein both as 'p. Arg197Ter' (with a space) and 'p.Arg197Ter'; the first (with the transcript) is recorded. Patient 1's consanguinity from 'His parents were first-degree cousins.'; applied to the sister because the paper says 'Both their parents'. No contradictions found within the paper.
